chapters.title: One
chapters.epigraph: A placeholder to prove the layout.

blocks.text:
This paragraph exists only to prove that the typesetting engine works: justified text, a first-line indent, and sensible leading on a 297 by 297 millimetre page.

A second paragraph follows, so the flow between paragraphs can be checked as well.
More body copy to push the chapter onto a second page and show the running head and folio in place.
Quotes get their own indented style.
The final chapter closes the sample.
